description: This file defines a PHP class SolarizedLightTheme that extends a Theme class, representing a color theme configuration for an ANSI to HTML converter, specifically implementing the Solarized Light theme with color mappings.

classes.name: SolarizedLightTheme
classes.description: A class extending Theme that provides an array of color mappings for the Solarized Light theme used in ANSI color rendering.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns an associative array mapping color names to their hexadecimal color codes for the Solarized Light theme.
